design.references: their targets: feat_* vs the scaled+smoothed decoder target; mel_corr etc. vs the LPCNet resynthesis of their raw stored targets (target_audio_source raw)
design.asr: wvx.asr.evaluate_wav, unconstrained (constrained is NaN when the reference has words outside the 50-word vocabulary)

splice_oracle.loss_note: loss = their train_step loss (Huber + 1.5 x Huber on features 4-9; dropout on; augmented data); val_loss = plain Huber, dropout off (Keras test_step); initial_validation = val_loss before training

splice_auto.loss_note: loss = their train_step loss (Huber + 1.5 x Huber on features 4-9; dropout on; augmented data); val_loss = plain Huber, dropout off (Keras test_step); initial_validation = val_loss before training

results.direction: differences are a - b; lower is better for ['feat_mse', 'mcd', 'asr_wer', 'asr_cer', 'asr_per']
